I saved Ilse's note to the knowledge brain: the signed order form for Tamsin Cold Chain is due 20 November. I also replied to her in her #north-team thread to confirm.

Before saving, I searched the brain for an earlier deadline and found none, so nothing on record disagrees with her date. That search was keyword-only, so a note worded differently could have been missed. A deadline is an operational date rather than a money figure, so it's fine to share with the North team.
